_comment: A UserPromptSubmit hook that re-surfaces the user-level CLAUDE.md each turn (it loads once at session start and fades over a long session). The install-claude skill merges this 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json and copies claude-md-reminder.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/. The command uses $HOME because a machine-specific absolute path can't be committed here; ~ never expands in hook command strings, and $HOME expands only if the harness runs the command through a shell rather than exec'ing it directly, so the skill rewrites this to an absolute path on machines where $HOME stays literal. UserPromptSubmit is an event where a hook's plain stdout is injected into the model's context; the script just prints one line pointing back at CLAUDE.md. It blocks nothing and the model may ignore it. No script logic at all — CLAUDE.md holds the actual guidance.
